name: drob_mite_p1
cmd:
O=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/drob_mite_p1; mkdir -p $O
python3 robot_build.py -- --robot nano_mite --out $O --stage sculpt --shots $O/shots > $O/sculpt.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/sculpt.log; exit 1)
python3 robot_build.py -- --robot nano_mite --out $O --stage game --tex 512 --ao 4 > $O/game.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/game.log; exit 1)
python3 robot_build.py -- --robot nano_mite --out $O --stage export > $O/export.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/export.log; exit 1)
for b in $O/*_hq.blend; do python3 robot_icon.py -- $b $O/strip --strip > $O/strip.log 2>&1 || tail -20 $O/strip.log; done
rm -f $O/*_hi.blend; ls -la $O
O=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/drob_mite_p1; mkdir -p $O
cat > /tmp/hv.py <<'PYEOF'
"""hv.py -- BLEND OUT.png ACTION f1,f2,... [az] [el] [size]: frames of a finished robot from the high game camera
(Cycles, the shipped meshes and textures), one tile per frame, fixed framing (ortho, centred on the rest bounds)."""
import sys, os, math
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector
import look
A = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1:]
BLEND, OUT, ACT, FR = A[0], A[1], A[2], [int(x) for x in A[3].split(",")]
AZ = float(A[4]) if len(A) > 4 else -35.0
EL = float(A[5]) if len(A) > 5 else 52.0
SIZE = float(A[6]) if len(A) > 6 else 0.0
bpy.ops.wm.open_mainfile(filepath=BLEND)
look.relink(BLEND)
sc = bpy.context.scene
arm = next(o for o in sc.objects if o.type == "ARMATURE")
arm.animation_data.action = bpy.data.actions[ACT]
for slot in getattr(arm.animation_data, "action_suitable_slots", [])[:1]:
    arm.animation_data.action_slot = slot
look.setup(samples=32, res=(480, 480), transparent=False)
lo = Vector((1e9,) * 3)
hi = -lo
for o in sc.objects:
    if o.type == "MESH":
        for c in o.bound_box:
            w = o.matrix_world @ Vector(c)
            lo = Vector(map(min, lo, w))
            hi = Vector(map(max, hi, w))
ctr = (lo + hi) / 2
size = SIZE or max(hi - lo) * 1.15
cam = bpy.data.objects.new("HV", bpy.data.cameras.new("HV"))
sc.collection.objects.link(cam)
sc.camera = cam
cam.data.type = "ORTHO"
cam.data.ortho_scale = size
cam.data.clip_end = 500
a, e = math.radians(AZ), math.radians(EL)
d = Vector((math.sin(a) * math.cos(e), -math.cos(a) * math.cos(e), math.sin(e)))
cam.location = ctr + d * 50
cam.rotation_euler = (-d).to_track_quat("-Z", "Y").to_euler()
from PIL import Image
tiles = []
for f in FR:
    sc.frame_set(f)
    sc.render.filepath = OUT + ".f%03d.png" % f
    bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
    tiles.append(Image.open(sc.render.filepath).convert("RGB"))
    os.remove(sc.render.filepath)
cols = min(4, len(tiles))
rows = (len(tiles) + cols - 1) // cols
sheet = Image.new("RGB", (480 * cols, 480 * rows))
for i, t in enumerate(tiles):
    sheet.paste(t, ((i % cols) * 480, (i // cols) * 480))
sheet.save(OUT)
print("HV", OUT)
PYEOF
python3 /tmp/hv.py -- $O/nano_mite_hq.blend $O/hv_Walk.png Walk 0,2,4,6,8,10 -35 52 0.9 > $O/hv_Walk.log 2>&1 || tail -20 $O/hv_Walk.log
rm -f $O/robot_hi.blend $O/robot_game.blend; ls -la $O
